Name: TID_HINT_0
Text: Hint: Click enemies to attack.

Name: TID_HINT_1
Text: Hint: Press 'I' to display your character sheet and open your bag.

Name: TID_HINT_2
Text: Hint: Place your items on the Quickbar to use them effectively in combat.

Name: TID_HINT_3
Text: Hint: Hire your friends as mercenaries to help you! Click the HIRE button next to their profile picture at the bottom of the screen.

Name: TID_HINT_4
Text: Hint: Click the minimap or press 'M' to open the World Map.

Name: TID_HINT_5
Text: Hint: Press <enter> to chat.

Name: TID_HINT_6
Text: Hint: Press <spacebar> to switch between your melee and ranged weapon.

Name: TID_HINT_7
Text: Hint: To see what another player is wearing, select the player with a mouse click, then click the 'Menu' button next to their profile picture.

Name: TID_HINT_8
Text: Hint: You can equip any item by double clicking it in your bag screen.

Name: TID_HINT_9
Text: Hint: You can use the number keys (1,2,3 and so on) to activate items on your quickbar.

Name: TID_HINT_10
Text: Hint: Meeting areas can hold up to 25 players at a time. If more players enter, a new \qclone\q of the meeting area is created.

Name: TID_HINT_11
Text: Hint: Crafting allows you to create useful items out of various ingredients.

Name: TID_HINT_12
Text: Hint: Click the Crafting button on the bottom right of your screen (or press the 'C' key) to open the crafting menu.

Name: TID_HINT_13
Text: Hint: Visit the shop to stock up for boss fights!

Name: TID_HINT_14
Text: Hint: Labycore's latest innovation, experience boosters, can be purchased from the quick store. Click 'SHOP' in the bottom menu bar to get yours!

Name: TID_HINT_15
Text: Hint: Tough fight? Use special weapons like Bazookas, Flamethrowers and Air Strikes to kick some butt!

Name: TID_HINT_16
Text: Hint: Use your Medikits when you're hurt, and toss plenty of grenades when fighting. You'll level up quicker and get better items!

Name: TID_HINT_17
Text: Hint: Hire a mercenary to enjoy co-op action even when your friends are offline.

Name: TID_HINT_18
Text: Hint: When you level up, remember to keep your gear up to date! Higher level weapons and items are a lot more powerful.

Name: TID_HINT_19
Text: Hint: Remember to visit the shop (key: S) to buy special weapons, cool items and new crafting plans!

Name: TID_HINT_20
Text: Hint: Item and weapon icons with blue or purple background are the most powerful.

Name: TID_HINT_21
Text: Hint: Color of an item icon defines its' quality and power: White [normal], Green [good], Blue [great], Purple [epic!].

Name: TID_HINT_22
Text: Hint: To create additional character or switch to another one, go to 'SETTINGS' and click 'CHANGE CHARACTER'

Name: TID_HINT_23
Text: *** Go to the Pirate Bay or Maze Pit to get new crafting plans for more damage ***

Name: TID_HINT_24
Text: *** Real damage is done with new craftable bullets to guns and special add-ons to melee weapons ***
